summary: Both trials used KSM-66 root extract from Ixoreal (named in Methods). 23439798 (64 stressed adults, 600 mg/day for 60 days) and 32021735 (60 stressed adults, 250 or 600 mg/day for 8 weeks) found lower perceived stress and cortisol versus placebo, with anxiety benefit only at 600 mg/day and sleep-scale benefit in the second trial. This resolves Dr. Pham's source-content hold for the exact stress-related relationship of this branded material; applicability stays limited to KSM-66 and stressed adults. Fourth-ruling boundary applied: supported outcome narrowed to stress (sleep removed); exact KSM-66 material required.

applicability.studied_population: Adults aged 18-55 with elevated perceived stress taking KSM-66 root extract 250-600 mg/day for 8 weeks or 60 days; not diagnosed psychiatric disorders.

identity.standardization: Root-only extract, at least 5%withanolides HPLC; no alcohol or synthetic solvents

population.description: 64 adults aged 18-54 with chronic stress (PSS >=14, WHO-5 <15), free of psychiatric conditions other than stress; 61 protocol-compliant in efficacy analysis; 41 men, 23 women.

study_contexts.study_design: single-center randomized double-blind placebo-controlled parallel trial

outcomes.name: Serum cortisol reduced versus placebo (P=0.0006); DASS and GHQ-28 scores also reduced

limitations: Outcome hierarchy not explicitly established by extracted paper sections; do not invent prespecified primary designation.
Different doses/outcomes not universal benchmark; study does not approve other ashwagandha materials.
Small short Indian adult trials; diagnosed psychiatric conditions not covered.
The primary objective was stress reduction, but no single primary scale is designated; PSS, DASS and GHQ-28 all favored KSM-66 (P<0.0001). Per-protocol efficacy analysis (61/64).
Mann-Whitney/t-test analysis of a 60-day single-centre trial; long-term effects not studied.
